preferences: defaults (a fresh HOME): new blending, groups not composed in CLI exports

cel_layer_opacity.what: RGB 24x12, 3 frames: layer opacity 1/127/254 (rows) x cel opacity 1/127/254 (frames) for normal, multiply, screen, overlay, hue, addition (columns), half-transparent pixels
commands: aseprite -b corpus/cel_layer_opacity.aseprite --sheet corpus/cel_layer_opacity.png --sheet-type horizontal --data corpus/cel_layer_opacity.json --format json-array --list-layers --list-tags --list-slices

group_blend.what: RGB 32x16, 2 frames: one group per blend mode (normal, multiply, screen, overlay, difference, color, addition, darken) with opacity 128/200/255/127/64/254/1/180, two overlapping children each, over an opaque pattern; header flag 2 (composed groups)
patched: header flag 2 and the groups' blend mode and opacity written by make_golden_corpus.py
commands: aseprite -b corpus/group_blend.aseprite --sheet corpus/group_blend.png --sheet-type horizontal --data corpus/group_blend.json --format json-array --list-layers --list-tags --list-slices

indexed_background.what: indexed 8x8, 8 colours, transparent index 3, 2 frames: a background layer using index 3 (opaque) under a layer where index 3 is clear
commands: aseprite -b corpus/indexed_background.aseprite --sheet corpus/indexed_background.png --sheet-type horizontal --data corpus/indexed_background.json --format json-array --list-layers --list-tags --list-slices

nested_groups.what: RGB 16x16, 2 frames: composed groups three levels deep (screen 180 > multiply 128 > difference 255), an overlay child, a hidden layer and a hidden group; header flag 2
patched: header flag 2 and the groups' blend mode and opacity written by make_golden_corpus.py
commands: aseprite -b corpus/nested_groups.aseprite --sheet corpus/nested_groups.png --sheet-type horizontal --data corpus/nested_groups.json --format json-array --list-layers --list-tags --list-slices

slices_keys.what: RGB 32x32, 6 frames: 9-patch, pivot, 9-patch + pivot and plain slices, with keys on later frames and hidden keys (width 0)
patched: slice keys after frame 0 written by make_golden_corpus.py, then re-saved by Aseprite
commands: aseprite -b corpus/slices_keys.aseprite --sheet corpus/slices_keys.png --sheet-type horizontal --data corpus/slices_keys.json --format json-array --list-layers --list-tags --list-slices

tags_directions.what: RGB 4x4, 8 frames of 40..215 ms: tags in the 4 directions x repeat 0/1/3, overlapping
commands: aseprite -b corpus/tags_directions.aseprite --sheet corpus/tags_directions.png --sheet-type horizontal --data corpus/tags_directions.json --format json-array --list-layers --list-tags --list-slices

tilemap_flips.what: RGB 16x8, 2 frames: a 4x4-tile tilemap with all eight x/y/diagonal flip combinations of two asymmetric tiles (and empty tiles) over an image layer
commands: aseprite -b corpus/tilemap_flips.aseprite --sheet corpus/tilemap_flips.png --sheet-type horizontal --data corpus/tilemap_flips.json --format json-array --list-layers --list-tags --list-slices

user_data_all.what: RGB 8x8, 2 frames: text, colour and properties of the types the Lua API makes (bool, int8..int64, uint8..uint32, double, string, point, size, rect, uuid, vectors, maps 3 levels) plus an extension map, on the sprite, a layer, a cel, a tag and a slice
commands: aseprite -b corpus/user_data_all.aseprite --sheet corpus/user_data_all.png --sheet-type horizontal --data corpus/user_data_all.json --format json-array --list-layers --list-tags --list-slices
